visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men are standing in a professional kitchen at a preparation counter. The man in the center wears a light grey t-shirt and is focused on chopping ingredients on a red plastic cutting board. To his right, another man in a white t-shirt is also preparing food. In the background, stainless steel shelves, pots, and kitchen staff in hairnets are visible under bright overhead lighting. (2) The man in the grey t-shirt continues his precise chopping while a man in a black shirt leans in from the left to observe. The camera stays in a medium shot, capturing the industrial kitchen environment with its white tiled walls and metallic surfaces. (3) The man in the white t-shirt holds up a large rectangular cleaver toward the camera. A tiny, orange, star-shaped piece of food is stuck to the side of the blade. He points at it with his finger and laughs, looking directly into the lens. (4) A man wearing a white tank top and a silver necklace holds up small, round carrot slices that have been intricately carved into animal faces with various expressions. He displays them one by one close to the camera, smiling as he shows off the heart-shaped eyes and star-shaped features on the carvings.
